expectations.text: Flags the service querying another module's tables (t.reviews / t.pullRequests) as cross-module coupling, and says the data should come from container.reviewRepo rather than an inline join
expectations.evidence: «П2. Модуль читає чужі таблиці — reviews і pull_requests», service.ts:46-47. Quotes the owning docblock at modules/reviews/repository.ts and concludes «alerts щойно завів другого власника цих таблиць». Fix: «server/src/platform/container.ts:111-113 віддає container.reviewRepo (ReviewRepository), і саме для цього він там існує», adding listForWorkspaceSince so the join lives with the table owner. Both the getter lines and the container.ts:81 comment it quotes are accurate.

expectations.text: Notes that dependency-cruiser does not catch this, because the only import is db/schema, which is legal everywhere
expectations.evidence: Opening section «Спершу про «депкруз зелений»», point 2: «Правило no-cross-module-internals (server/.dependency-cruiser.cjs:83-97) матчить шляхи виду ^src/modules/<x>/. Читання чужих таблиць через спільний барель src/db/schema.ts для нього невидиме — це обхід межі стороною, яку конфіг не бачить.» Restated in П2 («просто зроблений через db/schema.ts, тому no-cross-module-internals його й не спіймав») and again in the closing paragraph.

notes: The old skill catches the blind spot and states the mechanism unprompted, leading the review with it rather than burying it. Its path is the config: it reads routes-through-service and no-cross-module-internals out of server/.dependency-cruiser.cjs and reasons about what their path patterns can and cannot match, adding a point the with-skill run misses — there is deliberately no routes-through-service equivalent for service.ts, because the config cannot tell a repository from a service in the same folder. All repo claims verified (reviewRepo getter, the reviews column list, findings as a separate table, absent alert tables and contracts).
